messages:
mike.support: FYI - bluearc trial hit onboarding snag. Customer sees embedding requests failing ~45% and latency spikes to 3-5s on preview. They mentioned the renewal check-in next week, so this is time-sensitive. :warning:
carla.cs: thanks for flagging, mike. can you paste a short sample of the error and which route/model they're hitting? also are they on Hosted or Dedicated?
mike.support: Hosted. sample error from logs: 
```
HTTP 504 read timeout from inference-worker
{\"error\":\"kv-cache-miss\", \"model\":\"text-embed-redwood-003\", \"tenant_id\":\"acct-bluearc\"}
```
we're seeing a lot of retries and backpressure traces. request rate ~180 reqs/min during onboarding test.
jess.eng: looks like request pattern + long sequences triggered CPU-side queuing for that host pool. can we try a temporary routing rule to the lite embed model and enable prefix caching? config snippet: 
```
route: /v1/embeddings
preferred_model: text-embed-redwood-002-lite
cache: prefix_kv: true
retry_policy: 2
```
that should reduce tail latency while we investigate kernel selection.
carla.cs: agreeable. mike, can you apply that routing change as a temporary mitigation and confirm to customer? i'll coordinate account comms.
mike.support: applying now to tenant acct-bluearc, will monitor. ping back in 10.
incident-bot: Routing change applied to acct-bluearc at host pool eu-west-2. Change id: r-2026-06-03-01
mike.support: quick update - error rate dropped to ~8% after flip, p95 latency down to 600ms. customers still reported a single timeout during initial switchover.
carla.cs: great improvement. next: comms plan for renewal-risk mitigation: 1) immediate customer message explaining transient issue + mitigation + advocate contact, 2) schedule technical review call within 24h, 3) follow-up post-mitigation report and ask for formal feedback on onboarding. i'll draft the email.
naveen.ops: to prep, we'll need a short incident timeline, root-cause hypothesis and temporary config we used. jess, can you provide a brief writeup (2-3 bullets) for the customer-facing doc?
jess.eng: sure - draft: "Root cause: pooling and kernel selection under high sequence variance caused queueing on embed hosts. Mitigation: temporarily routed to lighter embed model + enabled prefix caching; engineering is tuning kernel selection and autoscaler thresholds to avoid recurrence."
carla.cs: perfect. mike, please add the customer to a 30-min call with carla + jess tomorrow 14:00 UTC. i'll cc AM and legal if needed.
mike.support: scheduled 2026-06-04 14:00 UTC, calendar invites sent to bluearc lead + AM.
carla.cs: action items for CS -> support handoff: 
- CS: send the short customer note + meeting invite (carla)
- Support: keep temporary route until engineering confirms stable fix (mike)
- Eng: provide RCA draft and ETA for permanent fix (jess)
- Ops: capture change id & retention for audit (naveen)
please update this thread when items complete. 
mike.support: marking temporary route retention flag, will update when removed. :white_check_mark:
carla.cs: also tagging this as P1 escalation for renewal-watch. sales notified.
incident-bot: Severity label updated: P1 (renewal-watch)
carla.cs: thanks team. will loop in AM and close after RCA + postmortem sent. :thumbsup:
